methods.description: Convert power in either direction using1000.
Multiply power in kW by hours, converting minutes first.
Multiply energy by tariff in dollars per kWh.
Find total operating time or repeated daily energy, including a stated fraction of full power.
Combine appliance power before multiplying by total operating hours.
Divide cost by tariff to find energy and divide energy by power to find hours.
Compare energy use and annual costs, then divide extra purchase cost by annual saving.
